internal-boundaries-plans.alt: Two copies of the same invented county, each a 5 by 5 grid of 25 blocks of 100 voters. In both, the three left columns (15 blocks) vote mostly for Party X and the two right columns (10 blocks) vote mostly for Party Y. Plan 1 draws five districts as the five columns, so X wins 3 seats and Y wins 2. Plan 2 makes the two left columns into two all-X districts and draws the other three districts as bent shapes that each hold 3 or 4 Y blocks and only 1 or 2 X blocks, so X wins 2 seats and Y wins 3.
